He holds a smartphone horizontally, displaying a video. His facial expression is focused as he speaks to someone off-camera. (2) A person wearing a long brown wig, representing a female character, runs vigorously on a treadmill inside a modern gym with STEPX branding. They are holding a large cup of pearl milk tea and a bag of fried chicken, eating while running. (3) In a cozy living room with a grey sofa and wooden floors, the man demonstrates a white leg massager. He shows the internal steel balls of the device, wraps it around his leg using Velcro, and presses buttons on the attached controller. (4) The man is seen relaxing on the sofa with both legs wrapped in the white massagers. Close-up shots highlight the control panel, showing LED indicators for different modes. He then packs the massager into a suitcase, showing its portability.
